our_interpretation: I assess the factual assertion that customer intake continued during capacity pressure and poor service availability. Greed is an evaluative description, not an independently measurable motive.
For this ongoing observation, I use April 2026, the latest complete calendar month before publication. The speaker did not specify an availability measurement window.
Availability should be measured separately for the main customer-facing services. An incident count or one component's uptime cannot establish an aggregate figure for all services.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that intake stopped during the capacity constraint, or that the relevant services consistently exceeded 99% availability during the target period.
